# ORIXNAL® — Founder-Led Global Brand Development Company

> ORIXNAL® is India's founder-led, high-conviction Brand Development Company helping ambitious startups, enterprise leaders, and D2C brands build clear, meaningful, and scalable masterbrands. Registered under the Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME Udyam: UDYAM-UP-28-0112879).

## Key Information
- Company Name: ORIXNAL® (ORIXNAL Group)
- Legal Entity: Micro Enterprise (Services)

## Core Service Pillars (The 8 ORIXNAL Pillars)
1. ORIXNAL Name: Strategic naming, company/product naming, tagline & slogan creation, domain & linguistic evaluation.
2. ORIXNAL Legal: Pvt Ltd / LLP incorporation advisory, Trademark search & Class 1-45 filings, copyright protection, IP licensing, contracts.
3. ORIXNAL Studio: Visual identity systems, logo design, packaging, luxury print collateral, design tokens, brand guidelines.
4. ORIXNAL Digital: High-performance React / Next.js web applications, Shopify e-commerce engineering, Web Vitals, technical SEO.
5. ORIXNAL Marketing: Go-to-market (GTM) strategy, positioning, brand architecture, retention mechanics, sales funnels.
6. ORIXNAL Ads: Targeted ad campaigns across Google, Meta, LinkedIn, billboards, TV, radio, print, and influencer integrations.
7. ORIXNAL Event: Corporate expos, conferences, stage setup, AV production, launch activations, VIP networking experiences.
8. ORIXNAL Consultancy: 1-on-1 Founder Advisory with Asim Khan, rebranding diagnostic audits, unit economics optimization.

## Sub-Brands & Ecosystems
- Foooz®: Everyday food brand ecosystem bridging farm-fresh sourcing with packaged consumer food products.
